label: Meditation III idea-of-the-infinite argument and the cogito, bridged to the maximum in being
summary:
2026-11-24, #1846. Result ed8bba54 extends the distinct content cause 4c815f13 to esse at the same c, retaining the original episode and bearer under 7067553d. Its positive model grants P1-P4 and actuality-to-being while the meditator surpasses its content cause at esse; the omission model keeps the meditator in esse and the cause in inf without esse. The impersonal occurrence-with-content proof needs no bearer for the weaker distinct-possessor conclusion. A two-state finite switch specifies an actually infinite extension on the standard natural numbers and differentiates content above every bound. At the intellectual respect, changing quantifier scope distinguishes a single actual knower from distributed or merely potential knowledge; the ground of knowledge can likewise be varied. These operations give positive warrant for finite partial content contribution, with no inference to a finite total source or to a grasp of unlimited substantial perfection in its unity. The stronger Cartesian reply, formal/eminent distinction, matching-scope tests, same-witness naming route, and substantive discriminator are in docs/notes/cartesian-infinity-content.md. The surpassed-cause model supersedes the earlier absence of a maximality omission control. Historical argument inventory and prior tests (2026-11-22): Analyst reconstruction, attribution deferred (navigation only: Descartes, Meditations II-III and the Second Replies; no source records). Formalized in TruthCore.Causality.CartesianIdeaOfInfinite over the shared GradesFrame F (IN_ACT_4, MORE_1, CAUSE_2, esse) and a separate IdeaFrame I whose primitive fields are the cogito binders Occurs and Bears, Represents (objective reality, definition 89b53040), ObjCause (cause of an idea's objective reality, definition d8e82792, not CAUSE_2), the respect inf (INFINITE_3, definition ef3ee5ec, appended to DISAMB-INFINITY) and the meditator me (definition f356048e). (1) RESULT 84ce0e39: P1 d3fcdeeb (an occurring idea borne by the meditator represents INFINITE_3), P2 0747e4f3 (the objective reality of every occurring idea has a cause), P3 3845020d (objective adequacy: whatever causes an idea's representing r is in act in r, IN_ACT_4, formally or eminently) and P4 4a9ede84 (the meditator is not in act in INFINITE_3) give 4c815f13: something other than the meditator is in act in INFINITE_3 and causes the meditator's idea of it. Non-transcription (distinctness is derived from P4); the comparator also checks a finite model where P1-P4 hold together. (2) RESULT 114e32ea (rejected reading certified): P3 is not an instance of the formal containment clause. On a frame whose only being is the meditator, the statement certifies that the meditator is in act in being, that the respect some false is had exactly by bearers of an occurring idea of INFINITE_3 and is had by the meditator, and that the meditator causes (CAUSE_2) its own being in act in every respect; there containment in every cause (634a80b8) and q.4 a.2 preexistence (64498e7e) hold with P1, P2 and P4 (the cause P2 supplies is the meditator), while P3 fails and nothing is in act in INFINITE_3. Strength of P3: it quantifies over every cause of an idea's objective reality, partial causes included, so it is stronger than the 'efficient and total cause' wording, and P3 with P4 entails that the meditator is not even a partial cause of its own idea's representing INFINITE_3. Unformalized siblings: a total-cause version (needs P2 strengthened to supply a total cause) and a degree-of-reality reading (the cause has at least as much formal reality as the idea objective reality, cf. 87f41688, which would need a calibration between objective and formal degrees). The strong version is used because the stated P2 supplies only some cause. (3) BRIDGE to the God-existence node. Proved (result 6de4168f): 4c815f13 with the new open bridge 1a289b83 (whatever is in act in INFINITE_3 is maximal in being, MAXIME_ENS_1) and the existing genus principle at being da09703b gives the quarta via conclusion 0881e859 (something maximal in being causes the being of every other being). 0881e859 is a premise of the existing GOD_4-existence arguments 678ff65f, 5d2b7c6e and 0e8e37dc (8626f8a5), so a new conditional support option for 8626f8a5 results: P1-P4, 1a289b83 and da09703b in place of 0881e859, with the other seven premises of the chosen route unchanged (each route keeps the open naming premise 1ec205ed, 7067553d, excluded middle, 09c6d5f0, eaa4c679 and its transfer/comparative premises). The bridge is a premise, not a definitional equality: inf and esse are unrelated respects. Positive warrant for 1a289b83 under the INFINITE_3 meaning (perfection without limit): a thing surpassed in being by another falls short of that other's being, which is a limit of its perfection; open in the frame. No existing statement mentions the inf respect, so none yields 1a289b83 without a further premise relating inf to esse or MoreIn (observation, no countermodel certified). Not available: INFINITE_1 (b0132989 runs from GOD_4 to INFINITE_1; using it for existence would need the converse, and Infinite is a predicate of beings, not the respect inf). The stronger reading 'infinite in every perfection' (in act and unsurpassed in every respect) entails 1a289b83 by instantiation and is not needed; not registered. Rejected: a direct naming bridge 'whatever is in act in INFINITE_3 is GOD_4' would give 8626f8a5 by a single application (invariant 16), a stronger bare leaf above a near-transcription (#1842); the maximality route instead joins routes that carry their own naming premise 1ec205ed. (4) COGITO. Existing premises supply an anonymous bearer: ThoughtOccurs e81971f1 with the bearer principle 30e6e01c gives Thinks x for some x. New: the first-person 22954087 (the meditator bears some occurring episode, ThinkingRootFork.Thinks at me) strengthens e81971f1 (result 2e0da6d9, relation registered; the existing subjectless control 6cffb105 suggests strictness but does not certify it for this pair, different vocabulary; a strength_comparison with a delta statement is a follow-up). It does not supply world-indexed existence (EveryBearerExistsAt c821487b is separate: Occurs is not world-indexed), concreteness, finitude (P4 is separate), substance, or identity of the anonymous bearer with the meditator. In the Meditation III argument the cogito supplies only the 'Bears me e' part of P1; P1 entails 22954087 by dropping the Represents conjunct (immediate, not registered). (5) RIVALS (substantive-objection standard). The negation-formed idea of the infinite (Gassendi/Hobbes-style): the meditator forms its idea of 'the infinite' by negating the limits of finite perfections it has. Two cases, with different targets. (i) The negation-formed idea represents INFINITE_3. Target: P3 at r = INFINITE_3; mechanism: the meditator is then a cause of the idea's objective reality without being in act in INFINITE_3, which conflicts with P3 and P4 together; the configuration is the one of result 114e32ea, so it is model-witnessed compatible with formal containment, PEPC, P1, P2 and P4. Justification status: the numbers example (finite reasoners form 'no largest natural number' by negating a bound) shows that negation yields concepts of unboundedness; it does not show that negation yields the positive content INFINITE_3, so case (i) has no independent justification on file yet. (ii) The negation-formed idea represents only unboundedness ('not finite'). Target: P1 (whether the meditator's idea represents INFINITE_3 at all), not P3; the numbers example supports this case, and the reply on record (navigation: Meditation III: the idea of the infinite is positive and prior to that of the finite) disputes it by the relevant difference positive versus negative content. So the objection has independent support only in case (ii), against the positive-content reading of P1; case (i) against P3 awaits a justification that negation yields INFINITE_3 content. This is not a checked incompatibility: P1 has no content siblings yet. Unresolved, kept open. P4: Descartes's own worry that the meditator might be potentially infinite does not target P3 here, since P3 requires act (IN_ACT_4), not potency. No substantive objection identified to P2 beyond the general causal-principle disputes already on file for causal premises, or to the bridge 1a289b83 under the INFINITE_3 meaning. Clear-and-distinct perception is not a premise, so the Cartesian-circle objection has no target. (6) Earlier rejected readings retained: finitude as 'every thinker lacks INFINITE_3' (stronger than needed and would make the cause a non-thinker); ObjCause is not added as a sense of the Cause disambiguation because it is a distinct compound relation with a distinct Lean type (B → Episode → R → Prop) from CausesIn (B → B → R → Prop), so no theorem can pass between them; the prose of 7aafbc69 names the two separately. (7) Meditation V is not duplicated (merged #1836, meditationFive). (8) Duper discovery (premise pool all, explicit targets): before and after, 0881e859 and 8626f8a5 stay unresolved; after, the conclusion 4c815f13 is rediscovered from exactly P1-P4 (filtered as the existing argument), while objective adequacy 3845020d and the bridge 1a289b83 stay unresolved, so no pooled statement, formal containment and PEPC included, supplies either.

Curation pass 2, lane D (#2103, 2026-11-27). 114e32ea tests 3845020d. Omit objective adequacy for the occurring idea. The only bearer is its own idea's objective cause and has the respect some false associated with representing the infinite, while lacking the infinite respect some true. The idea, objective causation and the meditator's lack of the infinite all hold in the same assignment.
blocker: For the existing root route, 1a289b83 must take this same cause from INFINITE_3 to maximal esse and the retained Stage 1 profile must name it under 1ec205ed. For P1/P3 test an actual content discrimination about intrinsic unity of unlimited perfections that resists the strongest finite composition at the same scope. Fix which concepts are already understood; explain the contribution needed and whether it requires formal or eminent possession by a partial or total source. For P4 establish the lack of eminent power under a calibration of IN_ACT_4; present ignorance supports only a formal limitation. A total-source sibling would require total coverage. See docs/notes/cartesian-infinity-content.md. The earlier proposed wider-perfections and cogito-strength comparisons remain separate questions.

current_assessment.scope: Positive content in the first-person idea of infinite substance, adequacy of its cause, and the same-cause passage to esse.
current_assessment.assessment: Finite composition explains a determinate infinite extension and discriminates actual undivided scope of knowledge from distributed or merely potential knowledge. The richer presentation of intrinsic unity and the transfer from causing that content to possessing its perfection still need warrant. The distinct content cause has esse conditionally at the same witness. Its maximality in esse and its naming as God require the existing bridges.
current_assessment.next_test: With the prior content of substance and the individual perfections fixed, identify a judgment about their intrinsic unity that sharing a subject and composing the known predicates cannot explain. Test whether the further contribution actually requires formal or eminent possession in a partial or only a total source.
current_assessment.evidence: Independent semantic challenge at ab774b58c accepted the finite-content comparison, limits of formal and eminent adequacy, and same-cause passage to esse. Result ed8bba54 and its four companions passed Comparator and scoped NanoDa. The reviewed outcome is published on research/comparing-explanatory-representations.
current_assessment.supersedes: The earlier characterization of the only worked finite rival as negative unboundedness, and the absence of a countermodel to maximality. The earlier full INFINITE_3 content gap persists.
